      • unsupported

        protected final javax.jcr.UnsupportedRepositoryOperationException unsupported()
                                                                       throws javax.jcr.UnsupportedRepositoryOperationException
        We throw this for operations that likely won't be needed, but could in theory be supported, but that'd be difficult / error prone. Motto: we rather throw an exception than to return wrong results.
